HexPlayer

an accessibile youtube browser for screen reader users
HexPlayer v5.1.0
What's New in Version 5.1.0
- Multi-Audio Track Selection:
  - Direct audio track selection menu in the video player context menu (Applications or Shift+F10).
  - Seamlessly switch between multiple audio languages, dubbed tracks, and commentary tracks with instant audio feedback.
- Audio Language Preferences in Settings:
  - Preferred Audio Language: Choose a default preferred audio track language (Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and 16+ other languages). HexPlayer automatically selects your preferred track when available.
  - Force Original Audio Language: New setting to always prioritize and play the original audio language track by default, falling back cleanly if dubs are present.
- Screen Reader & Keyboard Accessibility:
  - Full screen reader announcements when changing audio tracks and navigating track selections.
  - Keyboard-accessible radio items with instant status announcements.
- Internationalization (i18n):
  - Complete English and Arabic localization for all new audio track features, settings dialog controls, and status messages.
- Performance & Stability:
  - Asynchronous background track fetching with zero player UI freezes or delays.
